Raised by T01b's acceptance review as PLAUSIBLE (read, not reproduced: it needs a deliberately stalled git binary to measure). The fix, if the measurement justifies it, is to compute the re-measure BEFORE taking the lock, or to drop the per-call timeout for this leg. Low.
